scope: G05 RC09/10/11/23 three-registration owned-name consumer only; source and labelled synthetic tests

checks.procedure: Load test fixture source in-memory only and inject walletSubmissions increment into actorB ownedIdentities(cursor0) after B journal reopen. No source changes or services.

findings.scenario: Activity equality is asserted before owned-name rereads and for only the reopened actor. A reread can submit a transaction, or reopen can mutate the inactive actor, without rejection, yet journalReopenPreserved is reported true.
findings.repair: Capture both actor activity snapshots before each reopen and compare both after reopen plus both exact ownership rereads. Add reread side-effect and inactive-actor side-effect regression cases.

positiveChecks: Exact three NameRegistered payloads include pinned name hashes and complete packed readable metadata.
Both private owned sets, aligned canonical IDs, empty next page, and B fee-credit/no-collateral status checked.
Public summary omits grouped names and IDs; distinct actor/action references required; parent remains responsible for actual distinct accounts and canonical event attribution.
limits: No real proofs, sends, services, funding, encrypted journal or cold-PXE acceptance performed.
Concurrent uniqueness and broader observer privacy remain explicitly outside this consumer scope.
Parent must independently enforce real account separation, canonical callbacks, exact proof/fee totals and resource cleanup.
